title: Error Duration Amounts on Owed Courtesies — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
How long a misstated balance stood on a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account owed a service-recovery courtesy adds a dollar amount to the courtesy.

**Clause.** The error duration is the plain difference in days between the account's first statement date and the day the courtesy is posted: above 30 days adds 10.00 USD, above 14 days but not above 30 adds 5.00, and a shorter duration or no first statement date adds nothing.

| Error duration | Amount added |
|---|---|
| more than 30 days | 10.00 |
| 15 through 30 days | 5.00 |
| 14 days or fewer | nothing |
| no first statement date | nothing |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, first statement date 1 April).* Courtesy posted 2 May (31 days): 10.00. Posted 1 May (30 days): 5.00. Posted 16 April (15 days): 5.00. Posted 15 April (14 days): nothing.
